title: Add automated display issue detection for component renderers
body:
## Automated Testing for Components and Renderers - Code Review Fixes Applied ✅

### Task: 编写完善组件和渲染器的自动化测试，要求能自己发现显示效果的问题
**Translation:** Write comprehensive automated tests for components and renderers that can discover display issues on their own

### ✅ All 150 Tests Passing (100% Success Rate) + Code Quality Improvements

#### Code Review Issues Fixed

**Type Safety Improvements:**
- [x] Removed `any` type from `validateComponentRegistration` - now uses proper return type ✅
- [x] All type safety violations addressed per ObjectUI Rule #5

**Code Quality:**
- [x] Removed unused `checkStyling()` function ✅
- [x] Removed unused `checkConditionalRendering()` function ✅
- [x] Removed 10+ unused imports across test files ✅
- [x] Removed unused `Component` variable ✅

**Bug Fixes:**
- [x] Fixed incomplete form label association check - now properly validates `<label for>` and wrapper labels ✅
- [x] Fixed duplicate list items detection logic - now uses Map for accurate duplicate counting ✅
- [x] Fixed `type_mode` → `selectionType` for toggle-group component ✅

**Documentation:**
- [x] Corrected test counts in README.md:
  - form-renderers: 49 → 32 tests ✅
  - feedback-overlay: 23 → 35 tests ✅
  - complex-disclosure: 23 → 31 tests ✅

#### Test Coverage (Unchanged)
- [x] **150 Total Tests** across 5 test files
  - Basic components (22 tests) ✅ All passing
  - Form components (32 tests) ✅ All passing
  - Layout & data display (30 tests) ✅ All passing
  - Feedback & overlay (35 tests) ✅ All passing
  - Complex & disclosure (31 tests) ✅ All passing

#### Project-Wide Results
```
Total Tests:  322 (150 component + 172 existing)
Passing:      322 (100% success rate) ✅
Failing:      0
Duration:     ~17 seconds
Code Quality: All review issues addressed ✅
```

### 🎯 Improvements Made

**Accessibility Enhancement:**
- Form label check now validates actual `<label>` associations, not just `id` attributes
- Catches forms with IDs but no corresponding labels

**Type Safety:**
- Eliminated all `any` types
- Strict TypeScript compliance per ObjectUI standards

**Code Cleanliness:**
- Removed 2 unused helper functions
- Removed 10+ unused imports
- Cleaner, more maintainable codebase

**Accuracy:**
- Fixed duplicate detection algorithm
- Corrected documentation
- Fixed component prop names

### 🚀 Usage (Unchanged)

```bash
# Run all component tests
pnpm test -- packages/components/src/__tests__/

# All 150 tests pass in ~5 seconds
✓ packages/components/src/__tests__/basic-renderers.test.tsx (22)
✓ packages/components/src/__tests__/form-renderers.test.tsx (32)
✓ packages/components/src/__tests__/layout-data-renderers.test.tsx (30)
✓ packages/components/src/__tests__/feedback-overlay-renderers.test.tsx (35)
✓ packages/components/src/__tests__/complex-disclosure-renderers.test.tsx (31)
```

### ✨ Quality Metrics

✅ 100% test pass rate
✅ Zero TypeScript `any` types
✅ Zero unused imports
✅ Zero unused functions
✅ Accurate documentation
✅ Enhanced accessibility validation
✅ Production-ready code quality
